changelog:
- Initial release of acupoint-health-tool skill.
- Provides certified TCM acupoint massage consultation based strictly on four classic acupuncture texts, with sourced recommendations.
- Supports both Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE connections for universal MCP client access.
- Implements a privacy-preserving, registration-free client identity system based on device fingerprinting and session management.
- Includes built-in multi-turn clarification flow to ensure accurate consultation, with up to 3 rounds of follow-up questions.
- Enables sharing of consultation results and retrieval of referenced classical texts.
